senses.gloss: loḍayati (Skt. in mg. stirs, agitates), mixes, stirs in; Skt. āloḍayati has this mg. and is used in LV 〔269.14〕 (prose), but in 〔271.14〕 (vs), the same incident is told with: (gandhāmbu cūrṇāni ca) oruhyā nadi loḍayanti salilaṃ, descending into the river, mix perfumed water and powders into the (river-)water (two accus.).
